name: Healthcare
description: Medical and allied health careers: NEET and INI-CET preparation, FMGE for foreign graduates, nursing recruitment (AIIMS NORCET) and hospital roles.

rubric.description: Builds a logical differential from the case
Correct facts on mechanisms, investigations and management principles
Identifies what matters first and what is urgent
Recognises consent, confidentiality and safety issues

examCalendar.name: NEET-UG
examCalendar.notes: Entry to MBBS and allied courses; usually in May.

examCalendar.name: NEET-PG
examCalendar.notes: Timing has varied between March and August in recent years.

examCalendar.name: FMGE
examCalendar.notes: Held twice a year for foreign medical graduates.

safetyNotice: Exam and career preparation only, not professional medical advice. Consult a qualified clinician for any medical decision.
